8.1.6.2 Optional Interfaces
This section defines all interfaces that are required to fulfill an optional functionality of
the module.
[SWS_FrTSyn_00075] Definition of optional interfaces requested by module Fr
TSyn
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_20043

Csm_MacGenerate
Csm.h
Uses the given data to perform a MAC generation
and stores the MAC in the memory location pointed
to by the MAC pointer.
Csm_MacVerify
Csm.h
Verifies the given MAC by comparing if the MAC is
generated with the given data.
Csm_SignatureGenerate
Csm.h
Uses the given data to perform the signature
calculation and stores the signature in the memory
location pointed by the result pointer.
Csm_SignatureVerify
Csm.h
Verifies the given signature by checking if it was
generated with the given data.

Service to report runtime errors. If a callout has
been configured then this callout shall be called.
